name: People Profiles
description: Per-person markdown profiles auto-maintained from WhatsApp activity. Exposes people.* gateway methods so the agent can resolve a name to a profile and read it before claiming 'I don't have context'.

peopleDir.description: Directory holding per-person profiles. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/people/

workPeopleMd.description: Path to the legacy work/people.md table that supplies emails. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/work/people.md

selfJid.description: Self WhatsApp JID to exclude from DM partners. Defaults to inferring from from_me=1 rows.
